primary_endpoint.name: security_state_new_total
primary_endpoint.description: Number of testcases that triggered new security_state coverage transitions during the fuzzing run

primary_estimand.definition: θ = E[Δᵢ] where Δᵢ = SE_security_state_new_total_i - AE_security_state_new_total_i

analysis_population_definition.rule: All paired blocks where both AE and SE runs pass all applicable validity gates
analysis_population_definition.pair_exclusion_rule: A paired block is valid for analysis only if **both** the AE run and SE run within the pair pass all applicable validity gates

excluded_blocks.exclusion_reason: Block 1 evidence carried forward from prior R2 execution - no primary endpoint data in current R2 execution
excluded_blocks.exclusion_authorization: Explicit special adjudication in canonical ledger

excluded_blocks.exclusion_reason: SE primary endpoint data missing - SE carried forward (not rerun in R2)
excluded_blocks.exclusion_authorization: Frozen PAIR_EXCLUSION_RULE requires complete paired primary endpoint data
